errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the values on the y-axis represent percentages. This unit is clearly indicated by the '%' symbol in the data labels above each bar (e.g., '49,3%').

The description only details the highest and lowest bars and their values, completely omitting the middle bar for the category 'Ценова стратегия на база цени на конкуренти', which has a value of 31,5%. In a chart with only three data points, this is a significant omission.
